rows.note: Use 行為 as the all-purpose noun for a deed, an action viewed as conduct, or a display of behaviour.

example.english: This kind of act is really selfish.
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 hang4 wai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 zi6 si1

rows.note: Use 做 as the all-purpose verb for doing something or taking action.

example.english: I need to act now, so don't wait any longer.
example.traditional: 我而家要做嘢，唔好再等喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dang2 laa3

rows.note: Use 演戲 specifically for performing a theatrical role or acting on stage.

example.english: They act in a play at the theater tonight.
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam1 maan5 hai2 kek6 jyun2 jin2 hei3

rows.note: Use 幕 for one division of a play or other theatrical performance.

example.english: The second act is the funniest part of the play.
example.traditional: 第二幕係套戲入面最搞笑嘅一幕。
example.jyutping: dai6 ji6 mok6 hai6 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 zeoi3 gaau2 siu3 ge3 jat1 mok6

rows.note: Use 表現 for how a person or animal behaves or presents itself over a period of time.

example.english: You act very responsibly these days, so keep it up.
example.traditional: 你呢排表現得好有責任感，繼續努力。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 paai4 biu2 jin6 dak1 hou2 jau5 zaak3 jam6 gam2 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6

rows.note: Use 法案 for a proposed law that has not yet been passed.

example.english: This proposed act is still awaiting a vote in the Legislative Council.
example.traditional: 呢條法案仲等緊立法會表決。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 faat3 ngon3 zung6 dang2 gan2 lap6 faat3 wui2 biu2 kyut3

rows.note: Use 法例 for a law or statute that has been enacted.

example.english: This act has officially come into effect.
example.traditional: 呢條法例已經正式生效。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 faat3 lai6 ji5 ging1 zing3 sik1 saang1 haau6

rows.note: Use 扮 when someone deliberately puts on an appearance or feigns a feeling, rather than genuinely seeming that way.

example.english: Don't act pitiful; I know you're fine.
example.traditional: 你唔使扮可憐，我知你冇事。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 baan6 ho2 lin4 ngo5 zi1 nei5 mou5 si6
